projects.project_name: Climate-Smart Model Villages of Middle Gujarat: An ICAR–TSP High-End Initiative  Conceived and Led by Dr. M. L. Gaur (2010–2016) Founder Principal, College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, Anand Agricultural University, Godhra
projects.duration: Associated with Anand Agricultural University, Anand
projects.description:
During my tenure as Founder Principal and Dean, College of Agricultural Engineering & Technology, Anand Agricultural University (2010–2016), I conceptualised and led an ICAR-funded Tribal Sub-Plan (TSP) High-End Project to uplift the tribal communities of Middle Gujarat. 

The initiative was conceived, developed into a detailed project report at ICAR Headquarters, New Delhi, and secured national-level approval with a budget outlay of approximately ₹1 crore.

As the Principal Investigator and sole project designer, I introduced a multi-dimensional model integrating smart farm mechanisation, irrigation and soil-water conservation engineering, renewable energy, and mobile technology-enabled demonstration labs. 

These innovations aimed to deliver proven agricultural-engineering solutions directly to the doorsteps of tribal youth and women across the six districts of Middle Gujarat.

Key innovations included custom-hiring centres, women-led self-help groups, and skill-development training at the newly established #Godhra campus—turning it into a regional hub for rural technology transmission. 

The project was implemented under #Gujarat’s visionary Vansbandhu Kalyan Yojana, guided by the then Hon’ble Chief Minister Shri #Narendra Modi and Cabinet Minister Shri #Mangubhai Patel (currently Hon’ble Governor of Madhya Pradesh).

The model earned appreciation from successive state leaderships, including Hon’ble CM #Smt. Anandiben Patel (now Governor of Uttar Pradesh), visited the project site to witness its impact.

This initiative remains a benchmark of how visionary planning, participatory technology transfer, and relentless field engagement can transform tribal livelihoods through science, skill, and social innovation.

Like this, I had dozens of my infrastructure Dev, R&D, Field-based operational exposures & deliverables cutting across Disciplines/States/Positions/Stakholders/Sectors/Societies/Projects/Situations/Organizations in my 41 Years Tough Professional Journey

projects.project_name: Hydrologic and Economics Evaluation of Bamboo Plantations to Regulate, Monitor and Control Gullied and Ravines Under 3 Key Indian River Systems Namely Mahi, Yamuna and Chambal
projects.duration: It was an innovative R&D project , for which I was the sole creator and concept building, and winning it at national level from Govt of India under their National Bamboo Mission plan. In Gujarat, Rajasthan and UP , thousands of Bamboo based check dams were conceived and created with varied configurations to regulate and control soil and water erosion in Gullied lands of India. The beds of Gullied , the sides of Gullied networks, the banks of streams and yes the upstream zones from where gully formation often get initiated , were thoroughly learned and after ward best practices were earned and employed at multil locations more previously near Anand in Gujarat , near Kota in Rajasthan and near Agra in UP for Rivers namely Mahi, Chambal and Yamuna. The two specific nature given attributes of Bamboo namely its capabilities to create rapid root systems and thus sound reinforcement in soils , and the excessive tensile strength of this magic grass category vegetation was innovatively learned and earned for controlling Gullied areas via reduced soil erosion and sedimentation towards reservoirs and increased soil water storages and also ground water recharging at downscaled space-time grid. Varied science based technology driven sets of interventions were crafted by me , being the Founder Principle Investigator of this High end r&d projec funded (about 1 crore INR in 2007) from govt of India  via different ministries (Ag, horti). Dense net works of hydrologic instrumentation, structures, and data based outcomes were planned and successfully completed with huge real ground data . Later many books , papers , publications were crafted n published , it was when I was in research services (1985-2009) in ICAR @ARS1986 batch. Upon my shifting to University system (15 yrs) as Prof & founder Dean @Anand Agr University I felt high on it. After retirement, I am Vice Chancellor in Bihar and still have big ideas to propagate n exchange my wisdom basket, if due respect/position is offered
